Loading run record…

Ten planned topics · four consultation contexts · 4, 8 and 12 participants. Each source panel contains explicitly opposing recommendations, conditional support, minority concerns and uncertainty. Sizes are nested: they are not independent consultations.

Measured model outputs on synthetic inputs. The stronger evaluator passed eight authored control checks after the cheap evaluator failed. These remain provisional scores, not human-validated evidence or a test of the deployed extraction pipeline.

Extraction remains at the scoring ceiling: all 76 completed panels scored 100% before grouping. Grouping shows some losses. This does not establish perfect extraction: only two predefined meanings per participant were assessed, using a model judge. The larger sample has not resolved that limitation.

Semantic audit against original information

The judge is a separate model. Reference meanings were frozen before extraction. Full source paragraphs and model outputs are provided for review; evidence links are validated against returned claim IDs. These assessments remain provisional; the text is supplied so you can check its decisions.

Interpretation limits

    Coverage counts participant-linked reference units, not words. Repeated mentions count once. Only full preservation earns full coverage credit; partial preservation remains visible in the audit. Faithfulness measures whether each output claim is supported by the source. Neutrality, fairness and real-world correctness are not established by these scores.
